what: On a panel covered with a blur layer (backdrop-filter blur 10px + 20% stage-color shade), only a circle around the cursor is cut through so the photo and video below show clearly. The circle sits 50px up-left of the cursor and follows .4s late, on enter the radius opens to 150px in .2s, on leave it closes to 1px

options.shift: Distance (px) to dodge up-left from the cursor, default 50 — 0 puts it right under the cursor
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: Blur veil — empty element to cover the panel

from.where: index.html place-finder section (.rl-places) — original front-page inline (quickTo --x·--y .4 · --r 150px .2s · cursor −50px · mask radial-gradient)

note: On touch and reduced motion only the curtain covers and no hole opens (the original phone version also keeps only the curtain)
